name: You My Love
source:
Life is great! You have a cute boyfriend who would do anything for you, and you've never been happier. But what happens when your boyfriend gets a bit too possessive?

[From [url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/you-my-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活无比美好！你有一个愿意为你做任何事的可爱男友，你也从未如此幸福过。但当你的男友占有欲变得有点过头时，会发生什么呢？

[引自[url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/you-my-love]Itch.io[/url]]
